name: Nest Learning Thermostat 4th gen (US)

radios.note: Google's 4th gen specs list Wi-Fi 802.11n (2.4/5 GHz). No Google page we saw lists a Thread radio for this model, so it is left out.

matter.note: CSA lists the 4th gen as Matter certified over Wi-Fi (firmware 2.3, Matter 1.4, October 2025; an earlier 2024 listing covers firmware 2.1). Google says it works with Google Home and other Matter-enabled apps.

apple_home.note: Through Matter: add it to Google Home first, then link it to Apple Home. Google caps a thermostat at 5 Matter apps. Needs an Apple home hub.

google_home.note: Set up and controlled in the Google Home app.

alexa.note: Through Google's Nest skill for Alexa, enabled from the Google Home app. Google's thermostat comparison lists Works with Amazon Alexa for the 4th gen.

smartthings.note: No Google or Samsung page found lists this model. Only a SmartThings forum post mentions a Nest thermostat over Matter.

home_assistant.note: Official Google Nest integration using the Smart Device Management API, which Google says supports all Nest thermostat models; Google charges a one-time US$5 Device Access fee. Matter is a second route.

hubRequired.note: Connects over Wi-Fi and is set up in the Google Home app; no bridge needed.

localControl.note: No maker source states what works without internet. Home Assistant's Nest integration is cloud-based.

systems.value: Most 24 V systems, incl. heat pumps
systems.note: Google lists most 24 V systems (gas, electric, oil, forced air, heat pump, radiant). Use g.co/nest/works to check yours.

power.value: No C-wire needed in most homes
power.note: Google's specs page says it runs without a C-wire in most homes and that in limited cases (under 1%) a C-wire or Nest Power Connector is needed. Google's product page adds that heating-only, cooling-only, zoned and heat pump systems need one.

summary: Google Home is the main app for the Nest Learning Thermostat (4th gen), a US wall thermostat with Wi-Fi and Matter certification. That Matter listing is how it reaches Apple Home, and Home Assistant has an official Nest integration too. Alexa works through Google's Nest skill, and SmartThings is not confirmed. It runs without a C-wire in most homes and covers most 24 V systems.
caveats: Setup requires the Google Home app.
Google says heating-only, cooling-only, zoned and heat pump systems need a C-wire or Nest Power Connector; its checker is g.co/nest/works.
Google caps a thermostat at 5 Matter apps, and Apple Home also needs an Apple home hub.
